trivia_raiders.name: Sable
trivia_raiders.intro: A scarred raider named Sable watches you with a sawed-off across her lap.
trivia_raiders.correct_line: pays up with a sour grin
trivia_raiders.wrong_line: snarls and swings the stock at your head

trivia_raiders.name: Rook
trivia_raiders.intro: A wiry raider named Rook circles you, a knife loose in her hand.
trivia_raiders.correct_line: tosses the caps over with a wink
trivia_raiders.wrong_line: flicks the knife up and comes at you

trivia_raiders.name: Jinx
trivia_raiders.intro: Jinx grins from behind cover, rifle propped on her knee.
trivia_raiders.correct_line: laughs and slides the loot across the asphalt
trivia_raiders.wrong_line: snaps the rifle up to her shoulder

trivia_raiders.name: Gristle
trivia_raiders.intro: A broad-shouldered raider called Gristle blocks the way, chewing on a stimpak needle.
trivia_raiders.correct_line: gives up the stash with a grunt

trivia_raiders.name: Brick
trivia_raiders.intro: Brick, a raider with a face like a collapsed wall, leans on a rebar club.
trivia_raiders.correct_line: shrugs and kicks the stash over
trivia_raiders.wrong_line: hauls the club back over his shoulder

trivia_raiders.name: Cutter
trivia_raiders.intro: Cutter sharpens a machete nearby, watching you the whole time.
trivia_raiders.wrong_line: comes over the rail with the blade leading
